svg.text: Proactive conversation flow — context, gates, substance, and measurement
Client beats (concierge.js) → gates → full context → server beat prompt (index.ts) → substance gate → speak or hold.
Every number is admin config (Tuning → Engagement pace); user stories & acceptance criteria: DESIGN.md §2.10.
1 · Three beats can start a line
Opener — panel just opened
Speaks first — the open is peak attention. Signed-in 1.2s ·
anon 3s · live thread 1.1s · tapped-bubble follow-up 8s
openerSignedMs · openerAnonMs · openerReengageMs
openerFollowMs · openerCooldownMs
Idle nudge — panel open, visitor quiet
Only when the last word is the bot's. Five-step ladder
8s→30s→90s→3m→5m (repeats), scaled by the dial
nudge1Ms…nudge5Ms · assertiveness ×[1.5…0.65]
Re-engage bubble — panel closed
Was active, then idle. Server-composed from goals + patron;
sees its own recent lines — no repeats; holds when dry (22s)
reengageIdle*Ms · reengageMax* · bubbleWithdrawMs
2 · Client gates — a beat that fails one stays silent and names itself

g.text: quiet mode (time-boxed pause, quietMs — lifts by itself, on reload, or when they type) · follow-up budget spent (nudgeCap) · unacknowledged ≥ cap (unackedCap —
any sign of life resumes) · anonymous visitor hasn't typed yet (by design) · last word is the visitor's (reply, don't re-open) · another bubble
already on screen · post-sale congrats grace (reengageGraceMs) · demo mode

svg.text: Every skip is observable: FeierabendConcierge.status().lastSkip names the gate; FEIER_CX_DEBUG logs each one live.
beat request → edge function (a context note — never logged as the shopper's words)
3 · What every beat knows — the full context, injected fresh each request
THE PATRON — customer block (live state)

g.text: First name · standing tier (Wiederkehr / Hausfreund /
Stifter, from real LTV) · every order with status, cloth,
city, gift details · recency ("last here …")
Client book — notes from prior visits and actions,
rolled up into a summary; read invisibly, never recited.
House instructions — team-left errands (#id): exact
wording is the sole source; woven into service, checked
off after; resolved notes become content-free history.
Greet-on-opening-only — the "welcome back" banner
renders on the first beat of a visit, never mid-thread.
customerBlock() · auth-wait: no anonymous mis-greet

svg.text: THE CONVERSATION

g.text: Full transcript — including the device-kept history a
signed-in patron carries across closed tabs, so the bot
never restarts blind. Its own recent lines feed the
pending-question scan and the door check below.
historyKeepMs · pending-ask over the whole trailing run

svg.text: THE AGENDA — conversation goals

g.text: Admin-defined goals, filtered to the section the visitor
is reading, LLM-graded per conversation with cited
evidence. An UNMET goal is substance — it licenses a
beat once; met goals stop licensing. Never announced.
concierge_goals · goal_sample_rate · reengage_regrade

svg.text: THE HOUSE — how it sells & what it knows

g.text: Knowledge base (cloths, care, the mill) · SOPs filtered
by audience · the six moves (Ask · Recommend · Show ·
Advance · Reassure · Space) · assertiveness dial ·
selling angles (hooks) · objection playbook · voice.
all admin-editable, versioned — prompt-assembly.svg

svg.text: THE MOMENT + THE REGISTER (tools)

g.text: Which section they're reading · signed-in or not · post-
sale state. On TYPED turns the bot also calls register
tools (get_my_orders, changes, mending…). Proactive
beats run tool-less — the house reconciles afterwards
(auto check-off of carried-out house notes).

svg.text: 4 · The beat decision — ordered checks
Pending-question scan — the whole trailing run
if ANY unprompted line of the bot's still ends in an unanswered question → no question marks on this beat (statement or hold)
Door check — from the 2nd reach-out on
must open a subject not yet offered (care · another piece · the workshop); doors spent → hold, never invention
SALES LEDGER → ACTION TABLE beat_actions overrides · substanceGate
signed-in: computed numbers (orders · anomalies · post-sale window · unmet goals · spent actions) run ordered rules —
FIX_BLOCKED_ORDER → PROPOSE_COMPANION → PROPOSE_GIFT → ADVANCE_GOAL → KEEP_WARM → HOLD.
An unanswered proposal rests 24h → 3d → 7d (re-opened by fresh register news); decision + trace audited (beat_action).
SPEAK
1–2 plain sentences, a clerk's speech, at most one
image, every fact register-verbatim. On a buying signal
the commission button rides the same reply.
Reviewed by the reach-out judge before it ships (veto →
silent + beat_veto). Logged to concierge_messages.
counts against nudgeCap · unacked until sign of life
HOLD — silence as service
A typed beat_line {speak:false} — no token to leak.
Audited: a beat_hold row (Actions) → hold rate is real;
deliberate quiet ≠ breakage.
next try waits ×1.5 longer · rests after holdBudget
5 · The visitor always resets the dance

g.text: They type → quiet mode lifts, budgets reset, the pending question may be returned to, goals re-graded in the background.
Sign of life (scroll · tap · key · tab refocus) → the unacknowledged pause resumes a light presence.
“That's all for now” → quiet mode wins over everything until they write again.
Signed-in continuity: the transcript survives a closed tab (kept device-side, wiped on sign-out, historyKeepMs window) — the bot never re-pitches from scratch.

svg.text: 6 · How the merchant knows it's working

g.text: North star: ✳ concierge-initiated revenue & chat→commission rate (Conversion tab) — while the guardrails stay healthy:
Hold rate (beat_hold ÷ proactive beats): 0% at high beat counts = inventing content again; ~100% = mute. Both visible in Actions.
Quiet-mode / unacked pauses = the "chased" counter-metric · conversion by entry beat (typed / opener / outreach / nudge) = which beats sell.
Qualitative: per-conversation grades with cited evidence · gap flags · transcript drill-in · prompt-tuner critique.

svg.text: Beat engine + every knob: docs/beat-system.svg. Gate list & console diagnostics: BEHAVIOR.md. Prompt assembly: docs/prompt-assembly.svg. Metrics: ATTRIBUTION.md.
